sources_used.source: Google Maps place panels opened individually in the browser (anonymous view) - each address line copied verbatim including township and ZIP
Google Maps category searches in the browser (general contractor, roofing, plumber, HVAC, electrician, auto repair, tree service, pest control, locksmith, painter, junk removal, solar, machine shop)
Business websites (waderay.com, cleworthcomfort.com, pipemastersnj.com, buistinc.com, utilconstruction.com, doorsdoneright.net, circleautomotivenj.com, southbrunswickcontracting.com)
Houzz profile (one-off verification of a directory-only entry)

categories_thin: Pest control: no independent South Brunswick-based firm found. A Maps search for pest control near 08852 returned only out-of-town firms (Metuchen, Monroe/Jamesburg, New Brunswick, East Brunswick), and a Yellow Pages snippet naming an 'A Abbott' pest listing at 860 Ridge Rd could not be matched to any local pest-control business on Maps (860 Ridge Rd is Buist Inc.).
Locksmiths: no independent locksmith shop in the zone. Maps returned only addressless lead-generation listings and KeyMe key-duplication kiosks (a national brand).
Tree care: only one in-zone operator (7/24 Tree Service and Landscaping). Other results were East Brunswick-based (Raritan Valley Tree Service on Riva Ave) or published no address.
Painting: only one in-zone operator (A Stroke of Genius). The top-ranked painter near the zone, High Quality Painters on Adams Ln, is North Brunswick 08902.

Electrical: Accu-Mark and JRP are the only in-zone electrical listings that could be pinned to an address; the other high-ranking electricians (Hollander, Diamond, Rahman Services) publish no street address.
Junk removal / hauling: no South Brunswick-based firm. Results were 1-800-GOT-JUNK, College Hunks, and East Brunswick or Cranbury-area operators.
Machine shops / welding: none in the zone. Results were Cranbury (GMC Precision Machine), North Brunswick (IV Motors on Davidson's Mill Rd), New Brunswick and Somerset shops.
Solar: one in-zone installer found (Amergy Solar); other results were addressless or in Princeton/Franklin.
Pest control, locksmith, tree care, painting, electrical and junk removal remain the weakest categories after re-search.
caveats: Zone = South Brunswick township (Monmouth Junction 08852, Kendall Park 08824, Dayton 08810). Neighbouring townships were excluded even where a firm markets itself as serving South Brunswick.

Revision pass: the checker's rule was applied - every re-checked entry's address line was copied from the Google Maps place panel including township and ZIP. Entries whose notes say the town label comes from the original Maps pass were NOT re-opened; they are marked so the triage team knows which addresses still need a panel check.

Eleven entries were removed after the address check because they are outside the township: Alexander Plumbing (Blackhorse Ln, North Brunswick), Stearn Brothers Construction (Blackhorse Ln, North Brunswick), Ace Mechanical (Old Georges Rd, North Brunswick), George Logan Towing (Old Georges Rd, North Brunswick), Danley 911 Home Services (Cranbury-South River Rd, Monroe 08831), Ideal Tile Importing Co (US-1, North Brunswick, and a multi-showroom chain), LTD Nursery and Landscaping (only address is Bernardsville 07924), Water Management Incorporated (Davidson's Mill Rd, North Brunswick), Switchin' Kitchens & Baths (Davidson's Mill Rd, North Brunswick), Dennis & Don's Collision Center (US-130, North Brunswick) and GWS Environmental Contractors (Fresh Ponds Rd, Jamesburg 08831).

Two entries were re-labelled from 'Monmouth Junction' to the township Google actually prints (Kendall Park or Dayton) and three 'Dayton' labels on US-130 were corrected to Monmouth Junction; each is flagged in notes.

Ideal Tile was the only excluded-type entry found (regional chain). No food, government, school, hospital, worship, bank or large health-system entries were found. Doors Done Right (three NJ branches, family-owned) and the NAPA AutoCare member shop are kept, with notes explaining the borderline branding.
Several contractors register at home addresses; for solo/home-based operators the street address was withheld and marked Unknown.
Google's anonymous Maps view returns only top-ranked results per query, so each category is a ranked sample rather than an exhaustive list.

Outside-zone firms surfaced during the revision searches and deliberately not added: Any Auto Services (3161 NJ-27, Franklin Park 08823), Peter's Auto Repair (2893 NJ-27), High Quality Painters (Adams Ln, North Brunswick), 1-800 Water Damage of South Central NJ (335 New Rd - franchise brand), Raritan Valley Tree Service (Riva Ave, East Brunswick), GMC Precision Machine (US-130, Cranbury), IV Motors (Davidson's Mill Rd, North Brunswick).
data_gaps: yellowpages.com returned Cloudflare 403 to both fetch_content and the real browser throughout this session, so no bulk Yellow Pages cross-check was possible; manta, chamberofcommerce and whereorg were the same in the earlier pass.
Overpass API / OSM POI extract was unreachable, so no OSM-based completeness check was possible.
No public business directory was found on the South Brunswick township website.
Roughly 45 entries still carry the township label from the original Maps pass and were not re-opened individually during this revision; their notes say so.
Review counts and ratings quoted here come from the anonymous browser view and can be stale.
